Cuts a raster with polygons: keeps the cells inside them, or with the inverse switch the cells outside.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Vector, Intersect, Clip, Mask<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterVectorIntersector`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The polygons to cut the raster with. |
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to cut. |
| `doInverse` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, keeps the cells outside of the polygons instead of the ones inside. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The cut raster. |
